notes.title: Star Control 3 is Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h1]The classic game is now called “Star Control: Kessari Quadrant” [/h1]

[img]https://www.stardock.com/starcontrol/Screenshots/sc3/sc3_ss01.jpg[/img]

With the universe on the brink of total destruction and an epic adventure sprawling in front of you, what else is there to do but hop in a ship and take to the stars? Now you can experience all the action of Star Control 3 as it was originally released, right here on Steam! 

The final installation of the classic series, Star Control 3 features an exciting adventure of intergalactic strategy and diplomacy. This game diverged from the classic formula of the first two games and met with some critical reviews, but its story is still a very valued part of the series.

[img]https://www.stardock.com/starcontrol/Screenshots/sc3/sc3_ss02.jpg[/img]

Features
[list]
[*]Fascinating, rich story with lots of memorable characters and moments
[*]Detailed diplomacy system with interesting options
[*]Unique behaviors, goals, and motives for each race you encounter
[/list]
[img]https://www.stardock.com/starcontrol/Screenshots/sc3/sc3_ss03.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/358930

It’s been over 25 years since the first game’s original release and a new Star Control game is finally coming! Star Control: Origins is currently in development and is now available for pre-order. Purchase today for a special discount and future access to the Super Melee beta in late 2017!

Pre-order Star Control: Origins [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/271260]here[/url].
